why: Searches found no proof, disproof, or counterexample; the conjecture remains open and unrefuted, verified for all currently known Mersenne primes (including the October 2024 discovery of 2^136279841-1, which is simply a new instance consistent with the conjecture, not a resolution of it). No progress on the specific known potential counterexamples MM61/MM127 was found either.
